data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience, a public-stage biotech company founded by Amit Etkin, commands a current valuation of $1.04B after raising $253M in total capital. The valuation sits within a peer universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage comparable companies in Biotech & Health, supplemented by a broader comp set of 8 private peers and 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

The peer-median method proves the applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across three direct peers—Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M)—stands at $1.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $1.6B. A public-comp anchoring approach using sector P/S multiples (7.4x median across the 3 public tickers) cannot be applied, as the target's revenue figures are not on file. This limitation is typical for private company datasets.

The analysis supports a triangulated valuation range of $935M to $1.3B, with a median point of $1.1B. Alto's current $1.04B valuation aligns closely with the peer median, positioning the company at the lower end of the implied range. Key uncertainties center on revenue visibility and the tight methodological base—only one applicable method constrains confidence. Broader peer performance and biotech sector multiples compression post-IPO warrant monitoring for confidence in this band.
